caption: The drawing depicts a small sculpture of an animal resembling a dog or similar quadruped, positioned on top of an irregularly shaped pedestal. The animal figure is painted in a palette of light brown, tan, and dark brown spots, with additional highlights and shadows in pink and gray tones. Its mouth is slightly open, and its tail points outward and slightly upward. The pedestal beneath the animal is angular and rendered in shades of dark green and gray, giving it a rocky appearance. The base of the entire sculpture is rectangular and light green in color. The background of the drawing is an unadorned, pale beige color, and there is no discernible setting or additional objects present. Some red and gray text or initials are visible near the lower right and left edges of the image.
title: Carving
